result.summary: The food delivery app page appears largely functional and well-structured. Found a few minor layout and content issues related to text truncation and inconsistent card styling.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the edge of the screen, and the card itself is partially clipped.
issues.suggestion: This is expected behavior for horizontal carousels, but ensure the truncation uses an ellipsis and that swiping reveals the full card and name clearly.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons have inconsistent styling between the two 'Popular right now' cards. The ramen card has a white heart, while the pizza card has a dark/filled heart background, which may appear inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon appearance across all restaurant cards for visual consistency, adjusting for background contrast if needed.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with -20% badge) is missing its restaurant name, rating, and delivery details below the image, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all restaurant cards display consistent metadata (name, rating, delivery time/fee) or verify the info is simply below the current viewport fold.
